scope: Final integration audit: scope-to-proof map, integrated §12 sequences (SHARING, RESTART, REPLACE, INSERT, GROUP-HOLD, LAYOUT-END, LAYERS) through the real prepared-edit admission path with native artifact oracles, residual reconciliation, and as-built docs synchronization. No product behavior, compiler, schema or Group-format change.
invariants: Plain duplicate, Group repeat and Make Group Unique never create another Pattern runtime; only explicit Make Independent does, and explicit Rejoin collects the orphan.

Restart resets the clock and Pattern-owned state of the existing shared instance at first contribution; attaching or resizing an incoming Transition can move the trigger, a right split never inherits it, and a Group hold never retriggers it per frame.
Insert Time seeds one constant hold key at p and one resume key at p + d per affected track, transforms a shared instance track exactly once, and never resets runtime state.
A Group occurrence hold list, definition identity and instanceBindings survive move, linked duplicate, Make Unique and Ungroup; repeated insertion at one local time extends the same hold identity.
Layout Make Unique clones only that definition identity; a switch move or removal leaves Clips, Markers, Group choreography and Show End fixed, and Show End edits protect authored content.
A Layer keeps a stable identity through empty stretches; reorder changes only stacking; a destination whose materialized occupancy would collide refuses atomically.
Every refusal and no-op returns the original record identity and produces no write, history entry or timestamp.
partitions: Sharing: ordinary shared Clip, materialized Group child uses, linked Group repeat, unique Group occurrence, independent runtime, rejoined runtime.

Restart trigger: nominal start, incoming contribution window start after attach, window start after outgoing trailing resize, left split, duplicated placement, deleted placement, next loop crossing, coarse-step cold seek.
Replace: shared ordinary Clip (fork), definition-local Clip on a unique occurrence (linked definition untouched), Undo, Redo, reopened import.

Insert Time: gap, static Clip, animated Clip, exact discontinuity key, last key of a still-active track, shared instance track, zero time-scale runtime, Layout switch boundary, p = 0, strictly inside a visual Transition window, strictly inside a timed Layout transfer window.

Group holds: §7 worked example, repeat insertion inside an existing hold, move, linked duplicate, Make Unique, Ungroup, materialized internal Transition interior, overlapping effective instance track versus exact half-open adjacency.
Layout/Show End: repeated definition, Make Unique, switch move, plain removal, invalid shortening, valid extension, Undo, dormant Marker beyond Show End.
Layers: empty named Layer, reorder, colliding Group destination, accepted Group rebinding, plain removal of a vacated Layer, refused removal of a referenced Layer.
sequences: duplicate → create Group → duplicate occurrence → Make Unique → Make Independent → Rejoin (six admitted edits on one fixture).
create Group → duplicate occurrence → Make Unique → replace ordinary shared Clip → replace unique definition Clip → Undo → Redo.
refuse inside visual Transition → refuse inside transfer → insert in gap → insert at discontinuity key → insert at last active key → insert at Layout switch → attempt insert at zero.
refuse inside internal Group Transition → §7 insert 2000 at 5000 → repeat insert 1000 at 6000 → move occurrence → linked duplicate → Make Unique → Ungroup.
Make Layout Unique → move switch → remove occurrence → refuse invalid shortening → extend Show End → Undo.
add empty named Layer → reorder → refuse colliding Group bind → rebind to empty Layer → remove vacated Layer → refuse removal of the referenced Layer.
attach Transition → resize Transition → trailing resize outgoing → split → duplicate → delete → loop crossing.
oracles: Real closed admission (`admitShowV2Pilot*`) with a recording provider: write count, history `past` length, refusal with zero writes and preserved preimage identity.
Delivered native artifacts through `qualifyShowV2PilotArtifacts`: `.pxlshow` reopened by `parseShowFileBundle` equals the saved record, and the reopened import composition equals it.

Generated `.epe` source replayed by `createFastReplayRuntime` in Fast and Precise: exported `elapsed` against `t − lastReset`, shared advance of exactly one frame step while several users are visible, hold across a widened gap, zero advance for an explicit zero time-scale runtime, authored control curve after reset.

Compiled member identities: exactly one authored runtime member except where explicit independence or replacement created a second; the compiler's empty routed member is named and excluded rather than ignored.

Pure evaluation oracle for retained curves: `evaluateShowPropertyTrackV2` at hold interiors, the resume key, the retained source offset, the half-open activation end, and both steps of a preserved two-step kernel.
Structural equality of untouched owners: Group definitions, `instanceBindings`, Transition records, Markers and Clip arrays compared against pre-edit clones.
redEvidence: Sharing sequence initially failed on compiled member count because the compiler's empty routed member was counted as an authored runtime; the oracle was corrected to name authored members explicitly.
Replace sequence initially failed comparing whole records across Undo/Redo because adoption restamps `updatedAt`; the oracle was narrowed to composition equality.
Insert fixture initially failed public preparation (`unsupported-transition-property-track`) and then failed at p = 0; both were reduced to the smallest counterexample instead of being weakened away.

Group-hold fixture initially failed record validation because Group-local Transitions use the placement-pair shape, and later failed placement because the duplicate destination overlapped a linked occurrence.
Structure sequence initially failed on hard-coded Layout occurrence identities from v1 conversion.
faults: Make Unique drops the explicit occurrence `instanceBindings` (showGroupEditsV2.ts) — killed by the SHARING and GROUP-HOLD sequences.
Restart event derivation ignores the inferred incoming-Transition contribution start (showPropertyAnimationV2.ts) — killed by the RESTART and GROUP-HOLD sequences.

Insert Time hold key takes the authored key value instead of the evaluator's right-boundary value (showPropertyTrackTimeMappingV2.ts) — killed by the INSERT sequence after its discontinuity partition was strengthened.
Layout Make Unique clones the definition but leaves the occurrence pointing at the shared identity (showLayoutIntervalsV2.ts) — killed by the LAYOUT-END sequence.
Layer reorder keeps existing ranks instead of the requested order (showLayersV2.ts) — killed by the LAYERS sequence.
Ordinary Replace treats a shared runtime as sole-user and mutates it in place (showClipsV2.ts) — killed by the REPLACE sequence.

Not killed and reported honestly: weakening the record-level Clip overlap validator (showCompositionV2.ts) left both collision refusals intact, because the Group placement owner refuses first. The collision oracle therefore proves the owner guard, not the record validator.
